inputs.status: Exploratory sensitivity inputs, not selected dimensions or measured properties

tube.property_status: Uncertified generic analysis assumptions, not product test evidence

printed_material.accounting: Full-density net solid volume; no infill discount. Extra 25 percent for supports/waste is consumed material, not installed flight mass.

inputs.volume_scope: Assumed total custom printed load-carrying structure, gimbal frames, equipment retention features and landing legs; commercial bearings, fasteners, straps, servos and linkages excluded and unresolved.
inputs.comparison_warning: Shared lengths and volume sweeps do not imply equal stiffness, strength, mounting capacity or rotor clearance. Volumes are NOT measured CAD volumes.
inputs.price_basis: Whole stock/spools at retrieved displayed prices. No tax deduction or shipping added. Jaycar AUD inference is explicit. Complete ex-tax vehicle budget remains unknown.

A_SINGLE_SPINE.description: One load-carrying tube spine below the lower rotor; two outboard fork uprights route loads around the swept rotor to the common gimbal.

B_THREE_RAILS.description: Three longitudinal tube rails with printed connecting nodes/plates and two outboard fork uprights.
issues: Separated rails provide composite stiffness only with adequate shear transfer

C_PRINTED_TRUSS.description: Open printed truss with integrated mounting nodes, outboard fork and landing structure; no enclosing shell.

excluded_unresolved_items: Installed propulsion, battery, ESCs, controller/sensors, receiver and wiring
Commercial servos, bearings, linkage hardware, hubs/adapters and fasteners
Additional retention straps/pads, connectors and power distribution
Reusable printer, cutting/drilling tools, assembly and measurement equipment, priced separately
No assumed ownership, free components or zero-valued missing BOM rows

tube_section_derived.scope: Ideal unperforated tube only, not joined structure or gimbal stiffness

limitations: No automatic ranking: assumed printed volumes do not prove comparable structural function.
No historical travel, lever arm, mass or rotor spacing is adopted.
The spine/rails must end below the complete lower-rotor swept envelope. Forks, cross-members, fasteners and wiring require actual CAD clearance checks over selected motion.
Servo stall rating is not continuous torque; actual gimbal loads, rotor momentum and response remain unresolved.
No yield, buckling, fatigue, joint, landing-impact or printed-material qualification is computed.
Partial structural masses and material costs must not be reported as whole-vehicle compliance.
No current product drawing or image was interpreted. Stock and property confirmation remain necessary.
No PDR/CDR acceptance, fabrication permission or flight validation is implied.
